step1_analysis.description: An inductively loaded common-source (or common-emitter) RF amplifier. It uses a current mirror for biasing and features AC-coupled input and output, typical for RF front-end stages.

paper_reference.title: A Highly Integrated Dual-Band Triple-Mode Transmit IC for Cellular CDMA2000 Applications

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the amplifier stage

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Ibias = 1mA and a mirror ratio of 5 (W_m15/W_m14 = 50u/10u), the total current is 6mA. Power = 6mA * 1.8V = 10.8mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for a single RF stage in SKY130 1.8V, rather than the entire multi-band IC.

voltage_gain.description: AC voltage gain at the target operating frequency (1.9 GHz)

sky130_expected.calculation: gm ~ 20mA/V for 5mA bias. Load impedance at resonance with 50-ohm termination ~ 188 ohms. Gain = gm * ZL = 3.76 V/V = 11.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Single stage gain is limited by the 50-ohm load and inductor Q.

center_frequency.description: Frequency at which the AC gain reaches its maximum

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by L1 (10nH) and parasitic/load capacitance (~0.7pF). f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L*C)) ~ 1.9 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Tuned to match the PCS band (1910 MHz) mentioned in the paper.

vout_swing.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage swing under large signal RF input

sky130_expected.calculation: For a 0.1V amplitude input and gain of ~3.76, output amplitude is ~0.376V, giving a peak-to-peak of ~0.75V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on input drive level and compression point of the SKY130 NMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the RF amplifier measuring DC power, AC gain profile, and transient output swing. The original NPN transistors are mapped to SKY130 NMOS devices to support parameterized W/L.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RF Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_m14=10u L_m14=0.15u
.param W_m15=50u L_m15=0.15u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIIN IIN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1.9G 0 0)

* DUT (Adapted from NPN to SKY130 NMOS)
Ibias VDD N1 1m
M15 N0 N1 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w='W_m15' l='L_m15'
L1 VDD N0 10n
M14 N1 N1 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w='W_m14' l='L_m14'
C1 N0 Vout 1p
C2 N1 IIN 1p

* Load
Rload Vout 0 50

.control
* DC Analysis
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 50 100MEG 10G
let gain_db = vdb(Vout)
meas ac gain_1g9 find gain_db at=1.9G
meas ac max_gain max gain_db

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 5n
meas tran vout_pp pp v(Vout)
.endc

quit
